To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the performance of differential evolution is better than the other two algorithms in all the three feeding cases.
DE outperformed PSO and GA in the design of circular polarized microstrip antenna with probe feed and cross aperture coupled feed techniques.
DE outperforms other optimization techniques in the design of circular polarized antennas.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of CP microstrip antenna using three evolutionary algorithms and their performances are compared with each other.
the performance evaluation of three conventional evolutionary optimization techniques for the design of circular polarized microstrip antenna.
the design of circular polarization antennas using evolutionary algorithms, and the performance evaluation of evolutionary algorithms for the design of circular microstrip antenna.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
differential evolution with adaptive mutation is the best optimization technique in this particular application.
the differential evolution algorithm with a modified strategy of selection of trial vectors produces best results in terms of antenna performance parameters.
the differential evolution algorithm with advanced schemes performs best among the three algorithms in the design of microstrip antennas.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
differential evolution algorithm with advanced scheme performs best for the design of the circularly polarized antennas.
the particle swarm optimization technique is the best optimization technique for designing the microstrip antenna.
the advanced differential evolution scheme is the best performing optimization technique in all cases.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the advanced differential evolution technique outperforms the conventional differential evolution, genetic algorithm, and particle swarm optimization techniques for the design of circular microstrip antenna.
particle swarm optimization algorithm with its advanced schemes is found to produce the optimum design of circularly polarization microstrip antenna with the best performance.
the performance of evolutionary optimization techniques can be improved by tuning the control parameters of the algorithms using meta level particle optimization algorithm.
